entities.summary: Trevor Moore is an American professional ice hockey player who is a left winger for the Los Angeles Kings of the National Hockey League (NHL). While playing college ice hockey with the University of Denver, Moore was named to the NCAA Second All-American Team and NCHC Forward of the Year. Moore helped lead the American Hockey League (AHL)'s Toronto Marlies to their first Calder Cup in 2018.
